basic_info.description: Introducing SKY - the top-floor residence at Sol de Dolores, a bespoke three-home development by a world-renowned architect known for skyline-defining work in SF, LA, and Honolulu. Set in the heart of Mission Dolores, SKY is a private, light-filled sanctuary with curated finishes and expansive indoor-outdoor living. The great room opens to a U-shaped deck via floor-to-ceiling sliders, with a sculptural island anchoring the kitchen in Calacatta Roma porcelain. Miele appliances, brass fixtures, and Ronbow turquoise cabinetry contrast with fluted wood detailing, completing the space. The primary suite includes two built-out closets, a private front deck, and an ensuite bath with dual vanities, lantern-style tilework, and a glass-enclosed shower. A second bedroom opens to the front deck, while a third bedroom functions beautifully as a home office. The second bath features a gorgeous sunburst tile backsplash and floating vanity with custom under-lighting. MASSIVE private roof deck with sweeping views of Twin Peaks, Sutro Tower, Dolores Park, city lights and more. Wide-plank white oak floors, AC, Lutron lighting, Ubiquiti WiFi 6, solar, EV ready, 1-car garage parking + huge storage room. Elevate your life at SKY!
